description:
Install a NIGHTLY backup for one Docker Odoo instance (parity with the native backup_setup):
    a systemd timer (02:30, Persistent) that pg_dumps the DB out of the shared `db` container +
    tars the filestore out of the `service` container into `dest`, keeping the newest `keep`, and
    ntfy-alerts on failure. `ntfy_topic` blank → one is generated + returned. dry_run shows the
    script + units; confirm installs. Idempotent.

    OFF-SITE (optional): `s3_bucket=...` also pushes the nightly dump into S3-compatible object
    storage (default target Cloudflare R2) - dump to `sql/<db>/` on a daily retention, a monthly
    copy on the 1st, filestore copied file-by-file (never `sync`), every upload confirmed by
    comparing the object's size. Configure the box ONCE with `offsite_s3_setup` first: it is the
    same host-level rclone remote for both tracks, so there is no Docker-specific version of it.
    Bucket credentials never pass through this tool - they come from your secrets file.
name: docker_backup_setup
